info.title: Fenergo Nebula Audit Query
info.description:
The Audit Query API enables the retrieval of audit event data related to various activities within the system. It currently supports data for Journeys, Entities, Screening Tasks, and Financial Analysis events.
Version 2
Version 2 builds upon Version 1 by introducing paging to the resource and search term APIs, providing the following additional features:
  • The ability to retrieve audit events specific to an entity, grouped and summarized by each updated field.
  • The ability to retrieve audit events specific to an entity, which pertain to a specific field name.
  • The ability to retrieve audit events specific to a screened entity, which pertain to a specific field name.
  • The ability to retrieve audit events specific to a particular journey.
  • The ability to retrieve the users who have queried a particular entity.
  • The ability to retrieve Financial Analysis audit events

post.summary: Get Audit Events for a specific list of resource IDs in a paged manner.
post.description:
This method accepts a list of resource IDs and a pager object. The resource IDs indicate the records that are being sought, while the pager specifies the number of records to return in each page, the starting index of the first result, sorting field, and order (either "Ascending" or "Descending"). The resource IDs can refer to entities, journeys, or any other record type. The method then returns a list of audit events for each resource ID and a field indicating the total number of results.

Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: AuditAccessAndSearch

post.summary: Get Audit Events for a specific search term in a paged manner.
post.description:
This method takes in a list of resource IDs, a search term and a pager object. The resource IDs represent the identifiers of entities, journeys, or any other type of record, while the search term filters these records by either specifying a field name or a field value. The pager specifies the number of records to return in each page, the starting index of the first result, sorting field, and order (either "Ascending" or "Descending"). The method then returns a list of audit events for each resource ID and a field indicating the total number of results.

Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: AuditAccessAndSearch

post.summary: Get Entity Specific Audit Events, grouped and summarized by the fields that have been updated in a paged manner.
post.description:
This method accepts a list of Entity specific resource IDs and returns a list of Audit Events grouped and summarized by field name. Each returned record contains the original value as well as the last updated value. To retrieve a complete list of updated fields for an Entity, include all entity draft IDs in the request.

post.summary: Get all Audit Events specific to an Entity, for a particular field.
post.description:
This method accepts a list of resource IDs specific to an Entity and a field name, and returns relevant Audit Events filtered by the specified field in a paginated format. To retrieve a complete list of Audit Event entries for the specified field, make sure to include both the Entity ID and all its related Entity Draft IDs in your request.

Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: AuditAccessAndSearch

post.summary: Get Product Audit Summaries for a list of product IDs.
post.description:
This method accepts a list of product IDs and returns lightweight audit summaries for each product. The summary includes the product type, last updated by, and last updated date. This endpoint is optimized for fast initial load of product audit tables. For full audit details of a specific product, use the GetForMultipleResources endpoint with the product ID.

Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: AuditAccessAndSearch

post.summary: Get Entity Access Logs in a paged manner.
post.description:
This method accepts the Entity ID and filters, allowing for the retrieval of all Entity Access logs. The Entity Access Logs display a list of users who have accessed the specified Entity ID. The filters are optional and enable you to search for Entity Access logs by a specific user and/or within a specified date range.

Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: AuditAccessAndSearch

materialityChanges.description:
Field-level changes for an entity-level materiality assessment update. Populated when
the source audit event is a `BatchEntityUpdated` that mutated
`EntityMaterialityAssessment`. Mutually exclusive with Fenergo.Nebula.Audit.Query.Application.Dto.ScreeningAuditEventsDto.Matches in
practice — a single screening audit row represents either match-level changes or
materiality changes, not both.

impactedClientsChanges.description:
Per-client OGS follow-up decisions. Populated when the source audit event is a
`BatchEntityUpdated` on an OGS batch that recorded impacted-client decisions.
Each entry is a snapshot of the after-state for one client.

Null / empty for all other event types.

matchDocumentChanges.description:
Field-level changes for match document lifecycle events
(`MatchDocumentAdded`, `MatchDocumentRemoved`, `MatchDocumentStatusUpdated`,
`MatchDocumentArchived`, `MatchDocumentUnarchived`).
Null / empty for all other event types.
